components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #2f5ce0; color: #fff; font: 550 14px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(32,56,140,.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2650cc; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,92,224,.28); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(40,34,24,.16); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #1c1b18; font: 550 14px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,24,16,.05); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f6f5f1; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,92,224,.28); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(40,34,24,.16); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; font: 14px system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c1b18; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #2f5ce0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,92,224,.28); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 22px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e6f4ec; color: #1d7f55; font: 600 12px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pill::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(40,34,24,.09); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,24,16,.05), 0 2px 6px rgba(28,24,16,.04); font: 15px system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c1b18; }

components.name: Floating Toolbar
components.description: Contextual toolbar next to the selected element.
components.html: Text
components.css: .ds-ftb { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(40,34,24,.09); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(28,24,16,.04), 0 12px 32px rgba(28,24,16,.1), 0 24px 64px rgba(28,24,16,.06); font: 13px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ftb-label { font-weight: 650; font-size: 12px; color: #57534b; padding: 0 8px 0 6px; } .ds-tb { height: 30px; padding: 0 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #57534b; font-weight: 550; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tb:hover { background: #f6f5f1; color: #1c1b18; } .ds-tb[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #edf1fd; color: #2448b8; }

keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white paper (`paper`) behind white surfaces; never pure gray, never dark mode.
Soft, low-opacity, warm-tinted shadows with real offset and blur; borders at 9 to 16 percent warm ink.
Rounded but not bubbly: 8 to 14 px on controls and cards, 20 px on large panels, pills for status.
One accent, Haven Blue, for the primary action, the current selection and focus.
Plain-language labels; icons always come from the one stroked icon sprite.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Haven Blue marks the next step, the current thing, or focus. It is never decoration, and a view has one filled blue button.

rules.name: The Owner's Colors Rule
rules.body: Pagehaven never tints, filters or overlays the owner's site beyond the selection outline. The canvas is pure white so the site's own colors read true.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Font Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is size and weight within one family. Never add a second typeface to Pagehaven's own interface.

rules.name: The Paper-Not-Glass Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are opaque paper. The only blur is the sticky app header, so content scrolling under it stays legible.
